# Carlo & Leslie Moore

- [Carlo](../character/carlo.md) — Friend of — [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) — faithful dog companion and comfort to her · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) to read obituaries and gossip about local history and Owen Ford's effect on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) enters, the conversation shifts to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) mourning her old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), before [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) spend the holidays in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and return to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), where Captain Jim shares news that his life-book will be published.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) returns home alone and visits [Anne](../character/anne.md), explaining how [George](../character/george.md) Moore's memory returned and his sister took him home to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). She recounts her emotional struggles and guilt leading up to the decision for the operation, while [Anne](../character/anne.md) comforts her during her grief and confusion.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS
